assuranceProfiles.use: No AI behavior is present; the assurance artifact is explicitly skipped.
Bounded assistive AI with low consequence, no autonomous consequential action, and human verification.
User-facing, retrieval/memory-bearing, or operational AI whose failures can materially affect product behavior.
Consequential or autonomous AI, sensitive/high-impact decisions, or state-changing tools requiring the strongest gates and human authority.

controls.requirement: Models, providers, prompts, tools, skills, datasets, corpora, memory, and policies are versioned.
Deterministic tests and nondeterministic evals have datasets, rubrics, thresholds, and owners.
AI data has provenance, consent, classification, retention, residency, and deletion controls.
Retrieval quality, grounding, citations, source authorization, freshness, and tenant isolation are evaluated.
Prompt injection, jailbreak, disclosure, harmful output, and excessive-agency cases are tested.
Tools use least privilege, typed contracts, sandboxing, budgets, and human approval for consequential actions.
Session and durable memory are isolated, reviewable, expirable, and deletable.
AI traces record version, latency, token, cost, safety, tool, retrieval, eval, and feedback signals without sensitive payload leakage.
Per-run and per-tenant token, tool, retry, latency, and spend budgets are enforced.
Model, prompt, provider, and agent changes use regression evals, canaries, rollback, degraded modes, and incident response.
